name: bundled-theme-loader-local-require-beside-env-read
note: A bundled file (wrangler's vendored `colors`) that loads a theme by a __dirname-relative path — `require(__dirname + '/../themes/generic-logging.js')` — in the same file as a bulk env read from an unrelated bundled dep. A local-path dynamic require resolves to a file already shipped in the package and visible to the scan, so it cannot hide a network/exec sink the way `require(computedName)` can; co-locating it with a bulk-env harvest wrongly fired the token-exfil BLOCK. A computed NON-local require beside a bulk-env harvest still BLOCKs. Regression guard for the top-1000-B false-block fix.
